question: Which of the following is a sword dance meant to depict the martial art tradition of the Kumaoni tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chholiya**__.

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Choliya **is a sword dance** meant to depict the martial art tradition of the Kumaoni tribe in Uttarakhand.**
 
• It is a very old tradition mainly practised in Rajput weddings and other meets.
 
• Along with** swords and shields, **the dancers were dressed like** Kumaon warriors.**
 
• The dancer carries regional brass instruments like **Turi or Ransing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gair- **Folk dance of Rajasthan performed by Bhil community.
 
• **Kachchhi Ghodi- **Folk dance originated in the **Shekhawati region of Rajasthan. A special costume of the horse is worn by the dancers.**
 
• **Chari- **It is a kind of **female group dance of Rajasthan, females perform this dance by putting a water container. This dance describes the art of collecting water.**
 
• This dance is mainly common in **Kishangarh and Ajmer regions.**
